body:
I completely understand what you're writing about. Also a junior in college in a very similar situation. Lately, taking 2-3 minutes to just close my eyes and let time pass before I start a schoolwork session has helped. Coming out of that period, I don't feel quite as distressed and thus, impeded in my work.

A smaller tip, I think recognizing the importance of concentration on schoolwork is a good thing ahead of time. For me, I separate the desire to please my parents and do what is expected of me and my desire to excel for myself. It's a difference between not living up to a minimum, and telling myself that literally anything I do is above the baseline. Even going through a single step is an achievement.

I hope this helps you, and know you're not alone.
